en.headline: Tung Wah College apologises for false JUPAS admission emails to 11,000
en.dek: Human error caused an acceptance notice intended for successful applicants to be sent to every one of the 11,139 people who applied through JUPAS, the college said after issuing a rapid clarification.
body: Tung Wah College apologised on Wednesday after mistakenly emailing all 11,139 of its JUPAS applicants that they had been offered a place and should pay an acceptance fee by the following afternoon.

The college said the message had been intended only for those who had actually received offers, reminding them to confirm acceptance and settle the deposit. Owing to human operational error, the email went out to the entire applicant list on the morning of results day. Once the mistake was discovered, a clarification email was sent promptly, advising recipients to disregard the earlier message and rely solely on the official JUPAS main-round results.

The institution said it took the incident very seriously, had formed a crisis-management team and would review its messaging processes, email systems and staffing arrangements to prevent a recurrence. Formal offers, it stressed, are those published by the JUPAS office.

zh.headline: 東華學院誤向1.1萬聯招申請人發取錄電郵致歉
zh.dek: 校方指因人為操作疏忽，將原擬發給獲取錄者的確認電郵誤發予全部11,139名申請人，已即時澄清並成立危機小組跟進。
body: 大學聯招今日放榜，東華學院因人為疏忽，錯誤向全部11,139名申請人發出取錄通知電郵，提醒須於翌日下午5時前繳交留位費。
學院表示，該電郵原意是向獲取錄的聯招申請人發出，提醒確認取錄資格及限期前繳費。知悉事件後，校方已即時向受影響人士發出澄清電郵，呼籲毋須理會早上收到的訊息，正式取錄結果一律以大學聯招處公布的正式遴選結果為準。
東華學院對引起申請人的不便深表歉意，強調高度重視事件，已即時成立危機處理小組跟進，並全面檢視訊息發放流程、電郵系統及人手配合安排，承諾進一步優化監管及資訊發放機制，確保同類事件不再發生。
